newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks fall, NYSE sets curbs.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks fall, NYSE sets curbs.

text.p: Wall Street stocks tumbled in morning trading on Tuesday, prompting the New York Stock Exchange to set curbs at 0959 EDT/1359 GMT.
The Dow industrials shed about 54 points, or 0.70 percent, to 7718. The Nasdaq composite slipped about three to 1429.
Analysts said the U.S. May Consumer Price Index (CPI), which rose 0.1 percent, compared to the anticipated 0.2 percent rise, would not have a great impact on stocks.

Housing starts and industrial production figures also would not affect the market other than to give investors an excuse to sell stocks and take profits after last week's six-day record-setting run, analysts said.
